address: Hilton Orchard, Level 5, 333 Orchard Road, 238867, Singapore
bio: After a hiatus, the first Asian outpost of celebrity chef Nancy Silverton’s famed establishment Osteria Mozza reopened, now in a modern, rustic setting with a lively and inviting vibe. The small lunch menu features antipasti, salads, pizza and house-made pasta. The dinner menu steps up a gear to include her signature mozzarella dishes and other Italian specialties. The impressive wine list covers 280 labels from different regions of Italy....
